headline: Owns the actual Wirtz —
Umar just owns the pun
body: Umar named his whole team after Wirtz. Imad just drafted him. This week Wirtz scored, assisted and took max bonus for 13, every point of it for Heung Min Dad.
He signed an injured Mitoma, left him on the bench, and still put up 51. Top by 32 and playing the league on easy mode.

headline: Three weeks running —
wrong goalkeeper
body: Like picking the slow queue at the supermarket three weeks in a row. Kinsky started: 2. Verbruggen on the bench: 6.
Put up 51, a genuinely good week, and gained nothing, because Imad also put up 51. Still 32 back. Running on a treadmill and calling it a title race.

headline: Rihab vs his strikers —
a draw nobody wanted
body: Two weeks of agonising over Gonzalo or Awoniyi, and this week they both scored 2. The universe telling Rihab it doesn't matter. It never mattered.
Vuskovic did the real work with 12. Third place is comfy: 34 off second, 18 clear of fourth. The middle seat on a long flight.

headline: The FNN jinx strikes —
113 in two weeks, then 35
body: Last week we said nobody was hotter. Then he posted 35. We'd like to apologise to Vidhun, and also take full credit.
Thiago finished on -2, which is like going to the gym and coming home weaker. He's fourth by one point.

headline: Barry 16 —
the Flemming saga, part three
body: Barry scored two, made one and took max bonus: 16, the best haul in the league. Split the G FC are 1 point off fourth and acting like they've won the thing.
Meanwhile Flemming: dropped for Welbeck, re-signed for Welbeck, benched for 0. Like reordering the takeaway you swore off, then leaving it in the fridge.

headline: Top score of the week —
with three starters missing
body: Three of his starters didn't play. The bench walked on with 12, McGinn got 10, Cherki 9, and Munir finished on 59, the best in the league.
Winning the week with three no-shows in your XI is the most annoying thing in fantasy. Ask anyone who set their team properly. Up to sixth, and unbearable about it.

headline: Scores 49 —
gets overtaken anyway
body: Delap scored twice against City for 13, Ødegaard added 11, and Dulaj still slid to seventh. Like running a personal best and getting pipped on the line.
Another window, zero waiver claims. Dulaj treats the wire like terms and conditions: knows it exists, never opened it.

headline: Defence: 29 —
attack: 1
body: Roefs, Konsa and Castagne made 24 between them. Igor Jesus and Solanke made 1. A group project where the defenders did all the slides.
Two more waiver claims, worth 1 point combined. Ometh uses the wire like an online basket at 2am: add everything, regret it at checkout.

headline: Lowest score of the week —
and last place is closing in
body: 34 points, the worst in the league, and Sandaru is now only 7 behind. That feeling when the car behind you on the motorway starts flashing its lights.
The keeper call didn't help: Trafford got 10 on the bench while Lammens started for 1. Nine points left in the dugout. The gap is seven. Do the maths.

headline: Still last —
but now it's a chase
body: The gap to ninth was 14. Now it's 7. Bruno Fernandes, picked up after Munir let him go, scored 10 on debut. Charity shop find, works perfectly.
Isak chipped in 8. Last place is still last place, but for once it's starting to look temporary. Samithu, check your mirrors.
